class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.layer1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_size)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.layer2 = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.output = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_classes)
caption: forward() chains these; output stays raw logits, no softmax.

model = MLP(20, 64, 3).to(device)
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)

model.train()
for x_batch, y_batch in loader:
    x_batch, y_batch = x_batch.to(device), y_batch.to(device)
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss = criterion(model(x_batch), y_batch)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()

        correct += (predicted == y_batch.to(device)).sum().item()
        total += y_batch.size(0)
